Captured on 2026-11-04 for the Unity Version Control 11.x layout regression.

- `index.md`: https://docs.unity.com/en-us/unity-version-control/release-notes/11.md
- `2022.md` through `2026.md`: the corresponding `/11/<year>.md` pages linked by that index.
- `legacy.md`: the unchanged raw production snapshot fetched from the original single-page endpoint at 2026-11-04T04:32:10.110Z, before Unity split the history.

The prior snapshot and all five year pages describe the same 156 releases and 4,110 note items. Tests compare identities and full parsed content, excluding the intentionally changed source URLs.
